title: Cross-modal learning for SAR target recognition using optical vision foundation models
abstract: arXiv:2609.07753v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) is an important modality in a wide range of imaging applications due to its versatile, long range and near all weather operating capabilities. However, Automatic Target Recognition (ATR) remains a challenging problem due to limited labelled data, the strong speckle in SAR images and the significant domain gap between SAR and more abundant optical imagery. In contrast, electro-optical (EO) imagery benefits from massive datasets, clearer visual structure and powerful foundation models. In this work, we investigate how vision foundation models trained on optical data can provide class level supervision for SAR classification.   We propose a cross-modal EO to SAR prototype alignment framework in which a frozen EO encoder, based on a DINOv3 vision foundation model, is used to construct class level optical prototypes without requiring strict EO/SAR pairs. translated_title: 利用光学视觉基础模型进行SAR目标识别的跨模态学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.07753v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：合成孔径雷达（SAR）凭借其多功能、远距离和近全天候的工作能力，在广泛的成像应用中是一种重要的成像模态。然而，由于标记数据有限、SAR图像中存在强斑点噪声，以及SAR与更丰富的光学图像之间存在显著的域差距，自动目标识别（ATR）仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。相比之下，电光（EO）图像受益于海量数据集、更清晰的视觉结构以及强大的基础模型。在这项工作中，我们研究了在光学数据上训练的视觉基础模型如何能够为SAR分类提供类别级别的监督。我们提出了一种从EO到SAR的跨模态原型对齐框架，其中使用基于DINOv3视觉基础模型的冻结EO编码器来构建类别级别的光学原型，而无需严格的EO/SAR配对图像。随后训练SAR模型对SAR图像进行分类，同时……
tldr: 本文提出一种跨模态EO到SAR原型对齐框架，利用基于DINOv3的冻结光学编码器构建类别级光学原型，无需严格的EO/SAR配对数据即可为SAR目标识别提供类别级监督，缓解SAR标注数据稀缺和域差距问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cross-modal EO-to-SAR prototype alignment framework that leverages a frozen DINOv3-based optical encoder to construct class-level optical prototypes, enabling SAR target recognition with class-level supervision without requiring strict EO/SAR paired data.
